reports.title: Indice Harmonisé des Prix à la Consommation (INHPC/IHPC)
reports.publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INS), Guinée
reports.description: Guinea's national CPI, published monthly (January 2026 note confirmed: "14 522 relevés... chaque mois" [14,522 price observations... each month], base 2019=100, covering all 8 régions). INS Guinée's own document states verbatim: "Cet indice est harmonisé, car il utilise la même méthodologie que les pays de l'Union Economique et Monétaire Ouest Africaine (UEMOA)" [This index is harmonised because it uses the same methodology as the countries of the West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA)] — notable because Guinea is NOT itself a UEMOA/CFA-franc member state, yet explicitly adopts UEMOA's CPI methodology by name. Confirmed as standing boilerplate across both a January 2026 and an October 2023 edition of the same note. No COICOP or IMF CPI Manual citation found.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly; confirmed via both a January 2026 and an October 2023 edition of INS's own methodology note.

reports.title: Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS) 2016-2020
reports.publisher: Conseil National de la Statistique, Guinée
reports.description: Guinea's national statistics development strategy, published September 2017, hosted on INS Guinée's own domain. Names AFRISTAT explicitly twice: once generally ("l'appartenance de la Guinée à des organisations sous-régionales... AFRISTAT, AFRITAC-OUEST et CEA") and once as a specific planned activity ("Adapter et vulgariser les nomenclatures d'activités et de produits des Etats membres d'AFRISTAT" [Adapt and disseminate the activity and product nomenclatures of AFRISTAT member states]) — the latter is the strongest classification-standard citation found this round. Also names CEDEAO (ECOWAS) and "ZMAO" (West African Monetary Zone), but explicitly does NOT name "WAMA"/"AMAO" (the zone's administering agency) anywhere — searched and confirmed absent, not conflated with the zone name. Separately, AFRISTAT's own website confirms a dated bilateral "convention de prestation de services" signed 11 October 2022 in Brazzaville between AFRISTAT's Director-General and INS Guinée's Director-General.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational strategy document (2016-2020 planning horizon, now expired but the only such document located).

reports.title: Code Révisé des Collectivités Locales de la République de Guinée
reports.description: Loi Ordinaire L/2017/040/AN (dated either 24 February 2017 per its own text or 26 May 2017 per FAO/Ecolex metadata — discrepancy noted, not resolved this round). Article 2: "Les Collectivités locales... sont les Régions, les Communes urbaines et les Communes Rurales" [Local collectivities... are the Regions, Urban Communes, and Rural Communes] — préfectures are explicitly NOT collectivités locales under this code, distinct from régions. Articles 484 and 492 list specific state-to-region transfer mechanisms: "dotation de fonctionnement," "dotation d'équipement," "Fonds National de Développement des Collectivités Locales."

reports.title: Décret créant l'Agence Nationale de Financement des Collectivités Locales (ANAFIC)
reports.description: Decree establishing ANAFIC and the FNDL (Fonds National de Développement Local) — the operational channel implementing the transfer mechanisms named in gn-code-collectivites-locales-2017 Art. 484/492. Cites Article 22 of the "Loi de finances 2016" as its statutory basis.

dependencies.basis: Guinea's SNDS names AFRISTAT specifically as a planned source of nomenclature adaptation support ("Adapter et vulgariser les nomenclatures d'activités et de produits des Etats membres d'AFRISTAT"), matching the established pattern of reusing the shared afristat-ihpc-guide-2014 node when an institution is named as providing support, rather than minting a new per-country AFRISTAT document. relationship_type is 'cites' (not 'methodology_depends_on') because Guinea's own CPI methodology note (gn-ins-ihpc) attributes its methodology to UEMOA, not AFRISTAT directly — the AFRISTAT link here is at the strategy-document level, one step removed from the CPI itself.
